title: Uniform bound and uniform alpha-Hoelder bound for a bilinear-form field with C^1 components on a compact convex set
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, 0 < alpha <= 1, U an open subset of R^n, K a compact convex subset of U, L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm, and a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L) such that for all P, Q in L the scalar function x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] is C^1 on U. Then there is M with |a(x)[P][Q]| <= M ||P|| ||Q|| and |a(x)[P][Q] - a(y)[P][Q]| <= M |x - y|^alpha ||P|| ||Q|| for all x, y in K and all P, Q in L.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → K ⊆ U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖ ∧ |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖
